 Bolex Reporter, Volume 11
 1961
 Volume 11, Number 1
 Articles: "Bowling Highlight", Harold Hainfeld; "Why Not a Wall Screen?", Tom Sullivan; "An Introduction to Home Movies (Part IX)", Raymond C. Lawson; "Film the Moon In Eclipse", Peter A. Leavens; "That Junk In the Foreground", Ray Dantzler; "My Bolex is World Traveled", Harry McDougall; "Scenario For Speed", Burton McNeely; "Planning and Editing for Release Prints", Ira Latour and Hugh Pennebaker; "Underwater Movies... In An Aquarium", Lynwood M. Chace
 From this issue on, the Bolex Reporter was only published twice a year. The newly introduced 18-5 Projector is reviewed.
 32 pages
 1961-1962
 Volume 11, Number 2
 Articles: "Winter Ski Filming", Hans Gmoser; "Seven Rules of Successful Home Movies", Bob Mulqueen; "Zoom or Turret?", Ernst Wildi; "How the Pikes Peak Story Was Filmed", Harold Hainfeld; "The 'Miracle' of Time Lapse Filming", Ernst Wildi; "An Introduction to Home Movies (Part X)", Raymond C. Lawson
 Two new cameras, the D-8LA and P1 Zoom Reflex, are reviewed. A nice 3 page center spread folds out and colorfully displays all of the available Bolex cameras and accessories.
 32 pages
